source: A 3D bus game where you sit down on a bus and move through the road 3d jump movement all normal roblox things

image_prompt.text: A drivable road the bus travels along, wide enough for the bus mesh to turn without clipping
A shared open area on the route that the whole server draws from
A bus interior with rows of seats the player can sit down on, which is the main playable space

layout_placement.text: Seats on the bus the player sits down in
The bus itself as a play volume that moves along the road while players stand and jump inside it

notes: Classified Vehicle Sim rather than Racing because there is no lap or finish condition, which is the boundary this genre draws. Cart-ride games sit under Physics Sim here and are arguably closer to riding a bus, but the prompt names a road rather than a track, so the road preset was taken.
The playable space moves. Nothing in the shapes, options or pipeline codes expresses a play volume that travels through the map, so the moving bus is an id-null layout entry.
all normal roblox things was read as use default Roblox character behaviour and made no layout picks.
Two scales again: the bus interior is room-sized, the road it travels is not.

open_questions.ask: How long is the route - one street, or a whole city loop?
Does the player drive the bus or ride it as a passenger, and does the route loop or end?

theme: Modern Urban - ordinary city street and a public bus

coverage_missing.ask: Do you drive the bus or ride as a passenger?
Are there bus stops, other passengers, or traffic?
How long is the road - a street, or a city?
Modern city street, or something more stylized?

answers.ask: How long is the route - one street, or a whole city loop?
answers.answer: Use one short street route; keep the map small and focused on riding the bus.

answers.ask: Does the player drive the bus or ride it as a passenger, and does the route loop or end?
answers.answer: The player rides the bus as a passenger, sitting down while it moves. The route loops so players can stay on and keep riding.
